_meta.purpose: Curated developer-doc pages to ingest into the brain as source_system=developer_docs.
_meta.why_curated_not_crawled: A crawler over vendor docs is a politeness and ToS problem and would pull thousands of low-value pages. These are the pages the developer agent is told to ground side-by-side (CAP/UI5/Node) code in — see .claude/agents/developer.md.
deny: community.sap.com — cite-only. developer.md: anti-bot blocks automated fetch. Never add it here.
_meta.note_on_spa_docs: Some vendor docs are single-page apps whose HTML is a JS shell with no prose. webdocs_ingest.py reports those as SHELL rather than storing an empty page — check the run report before trusting a source.
_meta.ui5_is_absent_on_purpose: Measured 2026-09-03: ui5.sap.com is an SPA. Its sitemap.xml lists 1000+ URLs but they are all '#/topic/...' fragments — a '#' fragment is never sent to the server, so every one returns the same ~2.1 KB shell. docs/api/api-index.json (1.1 MB) IS fetchable but is an index of class/method NAMES, not usage prose, so it would not catch a bug like 'sortProperty does not sort sap.m.Table'. The viable route is the markdown source SAP publishes at github.com/SAP-docs/sapui5 (repo confirmed to exist) via the GitHub tree API — not yet wired. This matters: UI5 is the source that would have caught finding F-17 in SUPPLIER-PO-STATUS-VIEWER-FD-R2.
_meta.removed_404s: cap.cloud.sap/docs/guides/using-services, /guides/deployment/to-cf and /guides/deployment all 404 (checked with and without trailing slash). CAP serves no sitemap.xml, so paths must be confirmed by hand before being added here.
